rade_pass_forbidden_conditions: Any PASS on H-point/R-point without authoritative vehicle/package reference and traceable coordinate definition.
Any PASS on occupant packaging without vehicle-specific envelope, seating reference and clearance verification.
Any PASS on backrest angle/range/end-stops that treats model reference range or concept geometry as physical capability.
Any PASS on clearance/interference without adequate intended-contact classification and authoritative geometry/motion verification.
Any PASS on rail/hardpoint/BIW integration without controlled vehicle mounting geometry and relevant load-interface evidence.
Any PASS on materials without controlled material identity/grade/density/certification mapped to the intended V7 part.
Any PASS on PMI/GD&T/tolerances without released authoritative drawings/PMI and configuration control.
Any PASS on fasteners/preload without exact hardware identity plus controlled installation/preload data.
Any PASS on 130/170/180/joint behavior without actual required component characterization and traceable raw results.
Any PASS on critical load-path capacity based only on topology, geometric touching, or model motion.
Any PASS on CAE validation while critical inputs remain unresolved or the required solver/model execution evidence is absent.
Any PASS on crash/occupant safety, injury reduction, regulatory compliance, OEM approval, or manufacturing readiness without their corresponding evidence gates.
Any overall PASS that suppresses a known blocker or silently converts an assumption/reference/target into a confirmed fact.
